buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const cp=require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('client/package.json')) process.chdir('client'); cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio: 'inherit'}); const src='dist'; const targets=['../dist', '../client/dist', 'dist', 'client/dist']; targets.forEach(t => { try { if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, t, {recursive: true}); } catch(e){} });"
